# Third-party provenance

Spec Kit was initialized with the upstream CLI, not reconstructed templates:

```sh
uv run --project /path/to/spec-kit specify init workharbor --integration codex --script sh --ignore-agent-tools --non-interactive
```

Source: https://github.com/github/spec-kit
Commit: 0443760542e7e5269724744a2ac55c4bd386d095
CLI version: 1.1.4.dev0 (development snapshot, pinned by commit).
The generated `.specify/` infrastructure and `.agents/skills/` originate from this
snapshot. Its MIT notice is retained in `spec-kit/LICENSE`. The project constitution
is WorkHarbor-specific. Review release migration before upgrading; do not overwrite
project documents. No Symphony source is vendored. WorkHarbor is licensed under
the [EUPL-1.2](../LICENSE); the third-party MIT license does not license WorkHarbor.

## Phoenix scaffold

`apps/control_plane/` was generated by the official `phx_new` 1.8.15 installer
with Ecto/SQLite, binary IDs, HTML, LiveView and assets, excluding mailer,
dashboard, Gettext and generated agent instructions. Phoenix template provenance:
https://github.com/phoenixframework/phoenix/tree/v1.8.15/installer
Its MIT notice is retained in [phoenix/LICENSE](phoenix/LICENSE). The generated
vendored `assets/vendor/topbar.js` identifies topbar 3.0.0, MIT, Copyright 2024
Buu Nguyen; its full MIT notice is retained in [topbar/LICENSE](topbar/LICENSE).
Generated Phoenix welcome images/markup remain scaffold assets, not WorkHarbor
branding. Other fetched packages are not vendored; exact Hex checksums and
heroicons/daisyUI Git revisions are recorded in the control-plane `mix.lock`.
